subject: Acme Health demo availability — vendor intake outstanding
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Health demo — proposing times (vendor intake outstanding)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — excited to show a short demo of Redwood Inference for the Acme Health use case. We have a couple of slots next week for a 45-minute walkthrough + Q&A:

- Tue 9 Feb, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 10 Feb, 13:00–13:45 PT

One quick heads up from procurement on your side: our team was told that Acme requires a completed vendor questionnaire and an executed NDA before product demos with full technical depth. I attached a draft NDA (Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf) and included a link below to our standard intake form. If you want to run a high-level overview before intake is complete that's fine, but your security/procurement folks may want the deeper walkthrough after the paperwork is done.

Would you like us to hold the detailed slot and tentatively provision an engineering attendee, or do you prefer a shorter high-level session in the meantime?

Best,
Jasmine
--
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0179
Redwood Inference

Hi Jasmine,

Appreciate the follow-up and the NDA. Our procurement lead is copied (procurement@acmehealth.com) — they require the vendor questionnaire fully filled before we book the detailed technical demo with vendor engineers.

Can you confirm if the intake form is the one at the link you sent? We have someone traveling on Tue but Wed 13:00 PT looks promising if the intake is completed by then. If the questionnaire will take longer, we should push to the following week.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health demo — proposing times (vendor intake outstanding)

Alex — thanks for the quick reply.

We can be flexible. A couple of notes:

- The intake link Jasmine provided is the right form; it includes an initial security questionnaire and fields for SOC2 evidence and SSO requirements.
- If Acme needs time to complete it, we can do a 20-minute high-level product overview (no engineering deep-dive) on Wed 10 Feb at 13:00 PT. That slot will be with a solutions lead, not the backend engineer.
- If procurement finishes the questionnaire and signs the NDA by EOD Tue 9 Feb, we can keep the 45-minute technical walkthrough on Wed 10 Feb at 13:00 PT with an engineer. Otherwise, propose Thu 18 Feb for the full demo.

Also, Lauren — can you surface the standard SOC2 snapshot and SSO checklist to Alex so procurement can attach it to the questionnaire? I pasted the Drive link in case it's faster.

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Hi team,

Thanks for the materials. We completed the vendor questionnaire (file: Acme_vendor_questionnaire_2027.docx attached) and have routed the NDA to legal for signature — expect countersign by EOD Fri 5 Feb.

Because our Platform lead is traveling Wed, we prefer to move the deeper technical demo to Thu 18 Feb to ensure all stakeholders (security, SRE, integrator) can attend. That said, we're open to the 20-minute overview on Wed 10 Feb at 13:00 PT if Redwood can present the executive-level slide deck without diving into architecture or data flows.

Please confirm which option you'd like and who from Redwood will attend on 10 Feb if you choose the short overview.

Best,
